question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Adrointness"** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**Let's see the correct spelling of the following word:

__
 
• **Adroitness *(noun)* -** having or showing skill, cleverness, or resourcefulness in handling situations

 
 
• ***Eg. ***She is *adroit* at handling problems. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here we will be learning some other word meanings:

 
• **Sinister -** singularly evil or productive of evil

 
 
• ***Eg.*** There was something *sinister* about him.
 
 
 
• **Dexterous -** mentally adroit and skillful : CLEVER
 
 
• ***Eg.*** Her *dexterous* handling of the crisis 
 
 
 
• **Gauche - **lacking social experience or grace
 
 
• ***Eg.*** So lofty was her depreciatory manner that I felt myself* gauche* and was put on the defensive.
